title: Capability-announce dispatch returns 2.04 when CapabilityTable::insert refuses (Python resource returns 5.03)
description: Found by worker-1's audit of the landed 7nnl.3 dispatch (kimi-k3 verification pass, the 'real behavioral divergence from the mirrored Python resource'). rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:1746 ignores the bool returned by CapabilityTable::insert: a non-egress insert refused by the 25% egress reservation (capability.rs, table full with reserved entries protected) is silently dropped while the announcer still gets 2.04 Changed - a false-success claim that the capability was cached. The mirrored Python resource (python/.../capability_announce.py record path) returns 5.03 Service Unavailable on refusal. Fix: propagate the insert result - refuse -> 5.03 (spec-aligned with the Python resource), keep 2.04 only when the entry actually landed; then add the dispatch-level Rust test mirrors the reviewer flagged as missing vs the python resource cases: expired -> 4.03, kid/IID mismatch -> 4.03, seq-regression-then-recovery (5 reject -> 6 accept), table-full -> 5.03. Note: missing-peer-pubkey divergence (Rust 4.01 vs Python 4.03) is unreachable in practice (pre-dispatch trust-store gate) - leave as is. Also LICHEN_EGRESS updates refresh in place so the egress-reserved partition never refuses an egress refresh; the refusal path is non-egress inserts only.
